name: Anthropic: Claude Haiku 5.5
quirks: In long agent prompts at low effort it can stop early and hand the task back (provider docs).
tips: Keep working until everything asked for is done; stop only when blocked or before a risky step.
Run a real check (tests, build, or the changed command) before reporting a change done.
Don't add features, docs or refactors nobody asked for; mention them at the end instead.
bench: QuorX build benchmark (Oct 2026): through the harness 34 of 36 builds passed, 18.6 of 20, about $0.045 a build; one-shot 9 of 9 passed (18.3 of 20). Tool-call errors: 15 of 1,300 calls (1.2%).
